# Doors

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/doors.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Every door level scripts spawn with `SpawnDoor(type, pos, rot, {triangle1, triangle2}, number)`
([World objects: doors](../research/objects.md#doors)). The number was thought to be a lock kind; it is
the door's number in its level, which ties the level's navigation links to the door.

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every `SpawnDoor` call (484 doors in 45 levels). What the navigation links' kind `0x40` does,
    and who else reads the number, are not traced.

484 entries. Data: `research/references/doors.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `<level>:<number>`. |
| `level` | str | | The level whose script spawns the door. |
| `number` | int | | `SpawnDoor`'s fifth argument (door `+0xe0`): the door's number in the level, unique per level; the level's navigation links carrying it belong to the door. |
| `type` | str | | The door's object type (`SpawnDoor`'s first argument). |
| `pos` | list | | Position `{x, y, z}` in metres, game axes (z up). |
| `triangles` | list | | `SpawnDoor`'s fourth argument (door `+0xd8`, `+0xdc`): the two collision triangles the door owns. |
| `marks_links` | bool | | Whether the door's kind marks the navigation links of its number as kind `0x40` (the breakable doors). |
| `script` | str | | The script that spawns it (without `.lua`). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
